title: Two jobs, one load order
description: Convert and unclip both read the load order OpenMW reads, and both write plugins OpenMW loads as groundcover.

nodes.title: Your openmw.cfg
nodes.detail: The data folders, content files and groundcover= plugins OpenMW loads, found where OpenMW finds them.

nodes.title: Greenmote
nodes.detail: Reads that load order the way OpenMW does: its statics, its terrain, its textures and its water.

nodes.title: OpenMW
nodes.detail: Grass drawn as groundcover, standing on the ground this load order has.

nodes.title: convert
nodes.detail: Grass statics placed by your content files become groundcover.omwaddon; deleted_groundcover.omwaddon hides the originals.

nodes.title: unclip
nodes.detail: A groundcover plugin is measured reference by reference; what floats, sinks, sits on a road or water, or clips into a rock is fixed or deleted.
